   226→    pub fn load_csv_data(&mut self, csv_path: &str) -> Result<Vec<(usize, usize)>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
   227→        use std::fs::File;

   236→        let mut transaction_graph = Vec::new();
   237→        let mut csv_data = Vec::new();
   238→        let mut account_id_map = HashMap::new();
   239→        let mut next_account_id = 1u64;
   240→        
   241→        // Skip header line and parse CSV
   242→        for (line_num, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
   243→            if line_num == 0 { continue; } // Skip header
   244→            let line = line?;
   245→            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split(',').collect();
   246→            if parts.len() >= 3 {
   247→                if let (Ok(from), Ok(to)) = (parts[0].parse::<usize>(), parts[1].parse::<usize>()) {
   248→                    transaction_graph.push((from, to));
   249→                    
   250→                    let from_raw = format!("{}", from);
   251→                    let to_raw = format!("{}", to);
   252→                    let value_raw = parts.get(2).unwrap_or(&"1").to_string();
   253→                    
   254→                    // 规范化地址（小写、去空格）
   255→                    let from_norm = from_raw.trim().to_lowercase();
   256→                    let to_norm = to_raw.trim().to_lowercase();
   257→                    
   258→                    // 分配account_id
   259→                    let from_account_id = *account_id_map.entry(from_norm.clone()).or_insert_with(|| {
   260→                        let id = next_account_id;
   261→                        next_account_id += 1;
   262→                        id
   263→                    });
   264→                    let to_account_id = *account_id_map.entry(to_norm.clone()).or_insert_with(|| {
   265→                        let id = next_account_id;
   266→                        next_account_id += 1;
   267→                        id
   268→                    });
   269→                    
   270→                    // FungibleStore键ID（假设与account_id相同）
   271→                    let _key_from_id = from_account_id;
   272→                    let _key_to_id = to_account_id;
   273→                    
   274→                    // 计算行哈希
   275→                    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
   276→                    hasher.update(format!("{}|{}|{}", from_raw, to_raw, value_raw));
   277→                    let _row_hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
   278→                    
   279→                    // Store CSV data for mapping
   280→                    let transaction_data = TransactionData {
   281→                        from_address: format!("account_{}", from),
   282→                        to_address: format!("account_{}", to),
   283→                        amount: parts.get(2).and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(1),
   284→                        transaction_hash: format!("txn_{}_{}_to_{}", line_num, from, to),
   285→                        block_number: self.current_block_id,
   286→                        transaction_index: line_num - 1,
   287→                    };
   288→                    csv_data.push(transaction_data);
   289→                }
   290→            }
   291→        }
   292→        
   293→        // 生成row_tx_mapping.csv文件
   294→        if self.log_enabled {
   295→            self.generate_row_tx_mapping(csv_path, &csv_data, &account_id_map)?;
   296→        }
   297→        
   298→        self.csv_data = Some(csv_data);
   299→        println!("Loaded {} transactions from CSV", transaction_graph.len());
   300→        Ok(transaction_graph)
   301→    }

   303→    // 新增：生成row_tx_mapping.csv文件
   304→    fn generate_row_tx_mapping(
   305→        &self, 
   306→        csv_path: &str, 
   307→        csv_data: &[TransactionData],
   308→        account_id_map: &HashMap<String, u64>
   309→    ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
   310→        use std::fs::File;

   312→        use sha2::{Sha256, Digest};

   316→        let block_dir = format!("{}/block_{:03}", log_dir, self.current_block_id);
   317→        std::fs::create_dir_all(&block_dir)?;
   318→        
   319→        let mapping_path = format!("{}/row_tx_mapping.csv", block_dir);

   325→        } else if csv_path.contains("USDT") {
   326→            "USDT"
   327→        } else {
   328→            "UNKNOWN"

   330→        
   331→        // 写入CSV头部（精简版 - 删除可计算字段）
   332→        writeln!(mapping_file, "block_id,dataset,source_csv,row_number,tx_index,from_raw,to_raw,value_raw,from_norm,to_norm,from_account_id,to_account_id,key_from_id,key_to_id,included,skip_reason,row_hash")?;
   333→        
   334→        // 为每个交易写入映射记录
   335→        for (idx, transaction_data) in csv_data.iter().enumerate() {
   336→            let from_raw = transaction_data.from_address.replace("account_", "");
   337→            let to_raw = transaction_data.to_address.replace("account_", "");
   338→            let value_raw = transaction_data.amount.to_string();
   339→            
   340→            // 规范化地址
   341→            let from_norm = from_raw.trim().to_lowercase();
   342→            let to_norm = to_raw.trim().to_lowercase();
   343→            
   344→            // 获取account_id
   345→            let from_account_id = account_id_map.get(&from_norm).copied().unwrap_or(0);
   346→            let to_account_id = account_id_map.get(&to_norm).copied().unwrap_or(0);
   347→            
   348→            // FungibleStore键ID（假设与account_id相同）
   349→            let key_from_id = from_account_id;
   350→            let key_to_id = to_account_id;
   351→            
   352→            // 计算行哈希
   353→            let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
   354→            hasher.update(format!("{}|{}|{}", from_raw, to_raw, value_raw));
   355→            let row_hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
   356→            
   357→            writeln!(mapping_file, 
   358→                "{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}",
   359→                format!("block_{:03}", self.current_block_id), // block_id
   360→                dataset, // dataset
   361→                csv_path, // source_csv
   362→                transaction_data.transaction_index + 1, // row_number (1开始)
   363→                idx + 1, // tx_index (1开始)
   364→                from_raw, // from_raw
   365→                to_raw, // to_raw
   366→                value_raw, // value_raw
   367→                from_norm, // from_norm
   368→                to_norm, // to_norm
   369→                from_account_id, // from_account_id
   370→                to_account_id, // to_account_id
   371→                key_from_id, // key_from_id

   443→    /// Generate meta.json with run parameters and environment info
   444→    fn generate_meta_json(
   445→        &self,
   446→        block_dir: &str,
   447→        csv_path: &str,
   448→        tx_count: usize,
   449→    ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
   450→        use std::fs::File;
   451→        use std::io::Write;
   452→        use serde_json::json;
   453→
   454→        let meta_path = format!("{}/meta.json", block_dir);
   455→        let mut meta_file = File::create(&meta_path)?;
   456→
   457→        let dataset = if csv_path.contains("ETH") {
   458→            "ETH"
   459→        } else if csv_path.contains("USDT") {
   460→            "USDT"
   461→        } else {
   462→            "UNKNOWN"
   463→        };
   464→
   465→        let git_commit = std::env::var("GIT_COMMIT")
   466→            .or_else(|_| {
   467→                std::process::Command::new("git")
   468→                    .args(&["rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"])
   469→                    .output()
   470→                    .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
   471→                    .map_err(|_| std::env::VarError::NotPresent)
   472→            })
   473→            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
   474→
   475→        let build_profile = if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
   476→            "debug"
   477→        } else {
   478→            "release"
   479→        };
   480→
   481→        // Get actual Rust version
   482→        let rust_version = std::env::var("RUSTC_VERSION")
   483→            .or_else(|_| {
   484→                std::process::Command::new("rustc")
   485→                    .args(&["--version"])
   486→                    .output()
   487→                    .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
   488→                    .map_err(|_| std::env::VarError::NotPresent)
   489→            })
   490→            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
   491→
   492→        let meta = json!({
   493→            "block_id": format!("block_{:03}", self.current_block_id),
   494→            "dataset": dataset,
   495→            "source_csv": csv_path,
   496→            "tx_count": tx_count,
   497→            "concurrency_level": self.concurrency_level, // 使用实际传入的并发级别
   498→            "sample_period_ms": std::env::var("SAMPLE_PERIOD_MS")
   499→                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "50".to_string())
   500→                .parse::<u32>()
   501→                .unwrap_or(50),
   502→            "read_sample_rate": std::env::var("READ_SAMPLE_RATE")
   503→                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0.01".to_string())
   504→                .parse::<f64>()
   505→                .unwrap_or(0.01),
   506→            "git_commit": git_commit,
   507→            "build_profile": build_profile,
   508→            "log_output_dir": self.log_output_dir.as_ref().unwrap_or(&"./logs".to_string()),
   509→            "timestamp": SystemTime::now()
   510→                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
   511→                .unwrap_or_default()
   512→                .as_secs(),
   513→            "address_mapping_summary": {
   514→                "unique_accounts": tx_count * 2, // 估计值，每个交易有from和to
   515→                "fungible_store_keys": tx_count * 2,
   516→                "normalization_applied": true
   517→            },
   518→            "environment": {
   519→                "rust_version": rust_version,
   520→                "aptos_core_version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
   521→                "host_os": std::env::consts::OS,
   522→                "host_arch": std::env::consts::ARCH,
   523→                "cpu_count": num_cpus::get()
   524→            }
   525→        });
   526→
   527→        writeln!(meta_file, "{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&meta)?)?;
   528→        println!("Generated meta.json at {}", meta_path);
   529→        Ok(())
   530→    }

   532→    // 新增：处理交易映射
   533→    pub fn process_transaction_mapping(&self, transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction]) {
   534→        if !self.log_enabled || self.csv_data.is_none() {
   535→            return;
   536→        }
   537→        
   538→        if let Some(ref csv_data) = self.csv_data {
   539→            for (block_stm_index, csv_record) in csv_data.iter().enumerate() {
   540→                if block_stm_index < transactions.len() {
   541→                     // 记录交易映射关系
   542→                     if let Some(logger) = aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   543→                         logger.log_performance_metric(
   544→                             "transaction_mapping",
   545→                             block_stm_index as f64,
   546→                             Some(block_stm_index as u32),
   547→                             std::collections::HashMap::from([
   548→                                 ("csv_index".to_string(), csv_record.transaction_index.to_string()),
   549→                                 ("block_id".to_string(), self.current_block_id.to_string()),
   550→                                 ("mapping_type".to_string(), "CSV_to_BlockSTM".to_string()),
   551→                                 ("transaction_hash".to_string(), csv_record.transaction_hash.clone()),
   552→                                 ("block_stm_index".to_string(), block_stm_index.to_string()),
   553→                             ])
   554→                         );
   555→                     }
   556→                 }
   557→            }
   558→        }
   559→    }

   561→    // 新增：从CSV文件读取交易数据
   562→    pub fn load_transactions_from_csv(
   563→        &mut self,
   564→        csv_file_path: &str,
   565→        max_transactions: Option<usize>,
   566→    ) -> Result<(Vec<SignatureVerifiedTransaction>, Vec<CsvTransactionRecord>), String> {
   567→        let file = File::open(csv_file_path)
   568→            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to open CSV file: {}", e))?;
   569→        let reader = BufReader::new(file);
   570→        
   571→        let mut csv_records = Vec::new();
   572→        let mut transaction_graph = Vec::new();
   573→        let _address_to_account_idx: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
   574→        let _next_account_idx = 0;
   575→        
   576→        for (line_idx, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
   577→            if line_idx == 0 { continue; } // 跳过标题行
   578→            
   579→            if let Some(max) = max_transactions {
   580→                if line_idx > max {
   581→                    break;
   582→                }
   583→            }
   584→            
   585→            let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("Failed to read line {}: {}", line_idx, e))?;
   586→            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split(',').collect();
   587→            
   588→            if parts.len() < 3 {
   589→                continue; // 跳过格式不正确的行
   590→            }
   591→            
   592→            // 解析发送方和接收方账户索引
   593→            let sender_idx = parts[0].trim().parse::<usize>()
   594→                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid sender index at line {}: {}", line_idx, e))?;
   595→            let receiver_idx = parts[1].trim().parse::<usize>()
   596→                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid receiver index at line {}: {}", line_idx, e))?;
   597→            
   598→            // 确保有足够的账户
   599→            if sender_idx >= self.account_universe.num_accounts() || 
   600→               receiver_idx >= self.account_universe.num_accounts() {
   601→                return Err(format!("Account index out of range at line {}. Sender: {}, Receiver: {}, Available accounts: {}", 
   602→                                 line_idx, sender_idx, receiver_idx, self.account_universe.num_accounts()));
   603→            }
   604→            
   605→            transaction_graph.push((sender_idx, receiver_idx));
   606→            
   607→            // 创建CSV记录
   608→            let sender_addr = format!("account_{}", sender_idx);
   609→            let receiver_addr = format!("account_{}", receiver_idx);
   610→            let amount = parts.get(2).unwrap_or(&"1000000").trim().parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(1000000);
   611→            let timestamp = parts.get(3).unwrap_or(&"0").trim().parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0);
   612→            
   613→            csv_records.push(CsvTransactionRecord {
   614→                csv_index: line_idx - 1, // 减1因为跳过了标题行
   615→                sender_address: sender_addr,
   616→                receiver_address: receiver_addr,
   617→                amount,
   618→                timestamp,
   619→                transaction_hash: format!("csv_txn_{}", line_idx - 1),
   620→            });
   621→        }
   622→        
   623→        println!("Loaded {} transaction records from CSV", csv_records.len());
   624→        
   625→        // 生成交易
   626→        let transactions = self.gen_transaction_for_erc20(transaction_graph);
   627→        
   628→        Ok((transactions, csv_records))
   629→    }

   662→
   663→    pub fn gen_transaction_for_erc20(&mut self,transaction_graph:Vec<(usize,usize)>) -> Vec<SignatureVerifiedTransaction> {
   664→        let mut account_num_max = 0;
   665→        let mut seq_map: HashMap<usize, usize> = HashMap::new();
   666→        let mut signed_transactions = Vec::new();
   667→        for tuple in &transaction_graph{
   668→            account_num_max = account_num_max.max(tuple.0).max(tuple.1);
   669→            let sender = self.account_universe.account(tuple.0);
   670→            let receiver = self.account_universe.account(tuple.1);
   671→            let entry = seq_map.entry(tuple.0);
   672→            match entry {
   673→                std::collections::hash_map::Entry::Occupied(mut occupied)=>{
   674→                    *occupied.get_mut()+=1;
   675→                }
   676→                std::collections::hash_map::Entry::Vacant(vacant) => {
   677→                    vacant.insert(sender.sequence_number() as usize);
   678→                }
   679→            };
   680→            let txn = peer_to_peer_txn(
   681→                sender.account(), 
   682→                receiver.account(), 
   683→                seq_map[&tuple.0] as u64, 
   684→                1,
   685→                100
   686→            );
   687→            // println!("gen txn: {:?} to {:?} :{}",sender.account().address(),receiver.account().address(),1);
   688→            signed_transactions.push(txn);   
   689→        }
   690→        let transactions: Vec<Transaction> = signed_transactions
   691→            .into_iter()
   692→            .map(|txn| {
   693→                Transaction::UserTransaction(txn)
   694→            })
   695→            .collect();
   696→        into_signature_verified_block(transactions)       
   697→    }
   698→
   699→    fn execute_and_apply_transactions(
   700→        &mut self,
   701→        signed_transactions:Vec<SignedTransaction>,
   702→    ){
   703→        let signature_verified_transactions = into_signature_verified_block(
   704→            signed_transactions
   705→            .into_iter()
   706→            .map(|txn| {
   707→                Transaction::UserTransaction(txn)
   708→            })
   709→            .collect()
   710→        );
   711→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(signature_verified_transactions);
   712→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   713→        let output = block_executor.execute_block(
   714→            &txn_provider,
   715→            self.executor.state_store(),
   716→            aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_no_block_limit(),
   717→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   718→        )
   719→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   720→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   721→        output.iter().for_each(|txn_output| {
   722→            assert_eq!(
   723→                txn_output.status(),
   724→                &TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success)
   725→            );
   726→            self.executor.state_store().apply_write_set(txn_output.write_set()).unwrap();
   727→        });
   728→    }

   730→    fn execute_benchmark_sequential(
   731→        &self,
   732→        transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction],
   733→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
   734→    ) -> (Vec<TransactionOutput>, usize) {
   735→        use aptos_block_executor::counters;
   736→        use aptos_types::block_executor::config::{BlockExecutorConfig, BlockExecutorLocalConfig, BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig};
   737→        
   738→        let block_size = transactions.len();
   739→        
   740→        // Reset counters before execution
   741→        let execution_before = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   742→        let validation_before = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   743→        let abort_before = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get();
   744→        
   745→        let timer = Instant::now();
   746→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(transactions.to_vec());
   747→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   748→        
   749→        let config = BlockExecutorConfig {
   750→            local: BlockExecutorLocalConfig {
   751→                blockstm_v2: true,
   752→                concurrency_level: 1,
   753→                allow_fallback: true,
   754→                discard_failed_blocks: false,
   755→                module_cache_config: BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig::default(),
   756→            },
   757→            onchain: aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_maybe_block_limit(maybe_block_gas_limit),
   758→        };
   759→        
   760→        let output = block_executor.execute_block_with_config(
   761→            &txn_provider,
   762→            self.executor.state_store(),
   763→            config,
   764→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   765→        )
   766→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   767→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   768→        let exec_time = timer.elapsed().as_millis();
   769→        
   770→        // Calculate deltas for this execution
   771→        let execution_total = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - execution_before;
   772→        let validation_total = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - validation_before;
   773→        let abort = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get() - abort_before;
   774→        
   775→        // Note: Sequential execution, no stall mechanism
   776→        println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{}", 
   777→            execution_total, validation_total, abort);
   778→        (output, block_size * 1000 / exec_time as usize)
   779→    }
   780→
   781→    fn execute_benchmark_parallel(
   782→        &self,
   783→        transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction],
   784→        concurrency_level_per_shard: usize,
   785→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
   786→    ) -> (Vec<TransactionOutput>, usize) {
   787→        use aptos_block_executor::counters;
   788→        use aptos_types::block_executor::config::{BlockExecutorConfig, BlockExecutorLocalConfig, BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig};
   789→        
   790→        let block_size = transactions.len();
   791→        
   792→        
   793→        // 记录区块执行开始
   794→        if self.log_enabled {
   795→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution start: block {}, {} transactions, concurrency {}", 
   796→                    self.current_block_id, block_size, concurrency_level_per_shard);
   797→        }
   798→        
   799→        // Reset counters before execution
   800→        let execution_before = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   801→        let validation_before = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   802→        let abort_before = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get();
   803→        
   804→        // Reset BlockSTM logger stall statistics
   805→        if let Some(logger) = aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   806→            logger.reset_stall_statistics();
   807→        }
   808→        
   809→        let timer = Instant::now();
   810→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(transactions.to_vec());
   811→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   812→        
   813→        let config = BlockExecutorConfig {
   814→            local: BlockExecutorLocalConfig {
   815→                blockstm_v2: true,
   816→                concurrency_level: concurrency_level_per_shard,
   817→                allow_fallback: true,
   818→                discard_failed_blocks: false,
   819→                module_cache_config: BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig::default(),
   820→            },
   821→            onchain: aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_maybe_block_limit(maybe_block_gas_limit),
   822→        };
   823→        
   824→        let output = block_executor.execute_block_with_config(
   825→            &txn_provider,
   826→            self.executor.state_store(),
   827→            config,
   828→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   829→        )
   830→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   831→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   832→        let exec_time = timer.elapsed().as_millis();
   833→        
   834→        // Calculate deltas for this execution
   835→        let execution_total = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - execution_before;
   836→        let validation_total = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - validation_before;
   837→        let abort = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get() - abort_before;
   838→        
   839→        // Get real stall statistics from BlockSTMLogger
   840→        let (stall, stall_time_total, avg_stall_time) = if let Some(logger) = 
   841→            aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   842→            let stall_count = logger.get_stall_events_count() as u64;
   843→            // Get real total stall time in microseconds and convert to seconds
   844→            let total_time_us = logger.get_total_stall_time_us() as f64;
   845→            let total_time = total_time_us / 1_000_000.0; // Convert microseconds to seconds
   846→            let avg_time = if stall_count > 0 { total_time / stall_count as f64 } else { 0.0 };
   847→            (stall_count, total_time, avg_time)
   848→        } else {
   849→            // If logger not available, report zero stall statistics
   850→            (0u64, 0.0f64, 0.0f64)
   851→        };
   852→        
   853→        let tps = block_size * 1000 / exec_time as usize;
   854→        
   855→        // 记录区块执行结束
   856→        if self.log_enabled {
   857→            let successful_txns = output.iter().filter(|o| matches!(o.status(), TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success))).count();
   858→            let aborted_txns = output.len() - successful_txns;
   859→            
   860→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution end: block {}, {} transactions, successful: {}, failed: {}", 
   861→                    self.current_block_id, block_size, successful_txns, aborted_txns);
   862→        }
   863→        
   864→        // Print execution statistics 
   865→        println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{}, stall_count:{}, avg_stall_time:{:.2} us, stall_time_total:{:.2} us", 
   866→            execution_total,
   867→            validation_total,
   868→            abort,
   869→            stall,  // This is scheduler-level stall count (add_stall/remove_stall operations)
   870→            avg_stall_time * 1000000.0,
   871→            stall_time_total * 1000000.0
   872→        );
   873→        (output, tps)
   874→    }
   875→
   876→    // 新增：增强的并行执行方法，返回详细指标
   877→    fn execute_benchmark_parallel_with_metrics(
   878→        &self,
   879→        transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction],
   880→        concurrency_level_per_shard: usize,
   881→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
   882→    ) -> (Vec<TransactionOutput>, DetailedExecutionMetrics) {
   883→        use aptos_block_executor::counters;
   884→        use aptos_types::block_executor::config::{BlockExecutorConfig, BlockExecutorLocalConfig, BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig};
   885→        
   886→        let block_size = transactions.len();
   887→        
   888→        // 记录区块执行开始
   889→        if self.log_enabled {
   890→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution with metrics start: block {}, {} transactions, concurrency {}", 
   891→                    self.current_block_id, block_size, concurrency_level_per_shard);
   892→        }
   893→        
   894→        // Reset counters before execution
   895→        let execution_before = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   896→        let validation_before = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   897→        let abort_before = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get();
   898→        let suspend_before = counters::DEPENDENCY_WAIT_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   899→        let suspend_time_before = counters::DEPENDENCY_WAIT_SECONDS.get_sample_sum();
   900→        
   901→        let timer = Instant::now();
   902→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(transactions.to_vec());
   903→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   904→        
   905→        let config = BlockExecutorConfig {
   906→            local: BlockExecutorLocalConfig {
   907→                blockstm_v2: true,
   908→                concurrency_level: concurrency_level_per_shard,
   909→                allow_fallback: true,
   910→                discard_failed_blocks: false,
   911→                module_cache_config: BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig::default(),
   912→            },
   913→            onchain: aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_maybe_block_limit(maybe_block_gas_limit),
   914→        };
   915→        
   916→        let output = block_executor.execute_block_with_config(
   917→            &txn_provider,
   918→            self.executor.state_store(),
   919→            config,
   920→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   921→        )
   922→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   923→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   924→        let exec_time = timer.elapsed().as_millis();
   925→        
   926→        // Calculate deltas for this execution
   927→        let execution_total = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - execution_before;
   928→        let validation_total = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - validation_before;
   929→        let abort = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get() - abort_before;
   930→        
   931→        // Get real stall statistics from BlockSTMLogger
   932→        let (stall, stall_time_total, avg_stall_time) = if let Some(logger) = 
   933→            aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   934→            let stall_count = logger.get_stall_events_count() as u64;
   935→            // Get real total stall time in microseconds and convert to seconds
   936→            let total_time_us = logger.get_total_stall_time_us() as f64;
   937→            let total_time = total_time_us / 1_000_000.0; // Convert microseconds to seconds
   938→            let avg_time = if stall_count > 0 { total_time / stall_count as f64 } else { 0.0 };
   939→            (stall_count, total_time, avg_time)
   940→        } else {
   941→            // If logger not available, report zero stall statistics
   942→            (0u64, 0.0f64, 0.0f64)
   943→        };
   944→        
   945→        let tps = block_size * 1000 / exec_time as usize;
   946→        
   947→        // 记录区块执行结束
   948→        if self.log_enabled {
   949→            let successful_txns = output.iter().filter(|o| matches!(o.status(), TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success))).count();
   950→            let aborted_txns = output.len() - successful_txns;
   951→            
   952→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution with metrics end: block {}, TPS: {}, successful: {}, aborted: {}", 
   953→                    self.current_block_id, tps, successful_txns, aborted_txns);
   954→        }
   955→        
   956→        let metrics = DetailedExecutionMetrics {
   957→            execution_count: execution_total,
   958→            validation_count: validation_total,
   959→            abort_count: abort,
   960→            stall_count: stall,
   961→            avg_stall_time_us: avg_stall_time * 1000000.0,
   962→            total_stall_time_us: stall_time_total * 1000000.0,
   963→            execution_time_ms: exec_time,
   964→            tps,
   965→        };
   966→        
   967→        // Note: Detailed stall analysis available in generated log files
   968→        if self.log_enabled {
   969→            println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{} (detailed metrics in logs and return value)", 
   970→                execution_total, validation_total, abort);
   971→        } else {
   972→            println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{}, stall_count:{}, avg_stall_time:{:.2} us, stall_time_total:{:.2} us", 
   973→                execution_total,
   974→                validation_total,
   975→                abort,
   976→                stall,
   977→                avg_stall_time * 1000000.0,
   978→                stall_time_total * 1000000.0
   979→            );
   980→        }
   981→        
   982→        (output, metrics)
   983→    }
   984→
   985→    pub fn execute_blockstm_benchmark(
   986→        &mut self,
   987→        transactions: Vec<SignatureVerifiedTransaction>,
   988→        run_par: bool,
   989→        run_seq: bool,
   990→        concurrency_level_per_shard: usize,
   991→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
   992→    ) -> (usize, usize) {
   993→        println!("DEBUG: execute_blockstm_benchmark called with run_par={}, run_seq={}, concurrency_level={}", run_par, run_seq, concurrency_level_per_shard);
   994→        let (output, par_tps) = if run_par {
   995→            if concurrency_level_per_shard == 1 {
   996→                // For single core, use sequential execution path
   997→                println!("Parallel execution starts...");
   998→                let (output, tps) =
   999→                    self.execute_benchmark_sequential(&transactions, maybe_block_gas_limit);
  1000→                println!("Parallel execution finishes, TPS = {}", tps);
  1001→                (output, tps)
  1002→            } else {
  1003→                // For multi-core, use parallel execution path
  1004→                println!("Parallel execution starts...");
  1005→                let (output, tps) =
  1006→                    self.execute_benchmark_parallel(
  1007→                        &transactions, 
  1008→                        concurrency_level_per_shard,
  1009→                        maybe_block_gas_limit
  1010→                    );
  1011→                println!("Parallel execution finishes, TPS = {}", tps);
  1012→                (output, tps)
  1013→            }
  1014→        }else{
  1015→            (vec![],0)
  1016→        };
  1017→        output.iter().for_each(|txn_output| {
  1018→            assert_eq!(
  1019→                txn_output.status(),
  1020→                &TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success)
  1021→            );
  1022→        });
  1023→        let (output, seq_tps) = if run_seq {
  1024→            println!("Sequential execution starts...");
  1025→            let (output, tps) =
  1026→                self.execute_benchmark_sequential(&transactions, maybe_block_gas_limit);
  1027→            println!("Sequential execution finishes, TPS = {}", tps);
  1028→            (output, tps)
  1029→        } else {
  1030→            (vec![], 0)
  1031→        };
  1032→        output.iter().for_each(|txn_output| {
  1033→            assert_eq!(
  1034→                txn_output.status(),
  1035→                &TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success)
  1036→            );
  1037→        });
  1038→        (par_tps, seq_tps)
  1039→    }

  1041→    pub fn run_airdrop(&mut self, transaction_nums: usize){
  1042→        //initialize accounts
  1043→        let mut initialized_transactions = Vec::new();
  1044→        {
  1045→            for i in 0..self.account_universe.num_accounts(){
  1046→                let sender = self.account_universe.account_mut(i as usize);
  1047→                let txn = airdrop_initialize_txn(
  1048→                    sender.account(), 
  1049→                    1_000_000_000, 
  1050→                    sender.sequence_number(), 
  1051→                    100
  1052→                );
  1053→                sender.increase_account_sequence_number();
  1054→                initialized_transactions.push(txn);
  1055→            }
  1056→        }
  1057→        self.execute_and_apply_transactions(initialized_transactions);
  1058→        
  1059→        //execute airdrop transfer
  1060→        println!("execute transfer for airdrop...");
  1061→        let mut transfer_transactions = Vec::new();
  1062→        let acc_nums = self.account_universe.num_accounts();
  1063→        {
  1064→            let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
  1065→            for _i in 0..transaction_nums{
  1066→                let random_number: usize = rng.gen_range(0, acc_nums);
  1067→                let mut receivers = Vec::new();
  1068→                for _j in 0..5{
  1069→                    let random_number = rng.gen_range(0, acc_nums);
  1070→                    let &receiver = self.account_universe.account_mut(random_number as usize).account().address();
  1071→                    receivers.push(receiver);
  1072→                }
  1073→                let sender = self.account_universe.account_mut(random_number);
  1074→                let txn = airdrop_transfer_txn(
  1075→                    sender.account(),
  1076→                    receivers,
  1077→                    sender.sequence_number(),
  1078→                    100,
  1079→                );
  1080→                sender.increase_account_sequence_number();
  1081→                transfer_transactions.push(txn);
  1082→            }
  1083→        }
  1084→        let (par_tps, seq_tps) = self.execute_blockstm_benchmark(
  1085→            into_signature_verified_block(
  1086→                transfer_transactions
  1087→                    .into_iter()
  1088→                    .map(|txn|{
  1089→                        Transaction::UserTransaction(txn)
  1090→                    })
  1091→                    .collect()
  1092→            ), 
  1093→            true, 
  1094→            true, 
  1095→            num_cpus::get(), 
  1096→            None
  1097→        );
  1098→        print_tps!(par_tps,seq_tps);
  1099→    }

  1392→    pub fn replay_erc20_historic(
  1393→        &mut self,
  1394→        data_path: String,
  1395→        skip_parallel: bool,
  1396→        skip_sequential: bool,
  1397→        num_runs: usize,
  1398→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
  1399→        concurrency_level: usize,
  1400→    ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {

   244→fn observe_gas(counter: &Lazy<HistogramVec>, mode_str: &str, fee_statement: &FeeStatement) {
   245→    counter
   246→        .with_label_values(&[mode_str, GasType::TOTAL_GAS])
   247→        .observe(fee_statement.gas_used() as f64);
   248→
   249→    counter
   250→        .with_label_values(&[mode_str, GasType::EXECUTION_GAS])
   251→        .observe(fee_statement.execution_gas_used() as f64);
   252→
   253→    counter
   254→        .with_label_values(&[mode_str, GasType::IO_GAS])
   255→        .observe(fee_statement.io_gas_used() as f64);
   256→
   257→    counter
   258→        .with_label_values(&[mode_str, GasType::NON_STORAGE_GAS])
   259→        .observe((fee_statement.execution_gas_used() + fee_statement.io_gas_used()) as f64);
   260→
   261→    counter
   262→        .with_label_values(&[mode_str, GasType::STORAGE_FEE])
   263→        .observe(fee_statement.storage_fee_used() as f64);
   264→
   265→    counter
   266→        .with_label_values(&[mode_str, GasType::STORAGE_FEE_REFUND])
   267→        .observe(fee_statement.storage_fee_refund() as f64);
   268→}
   269→
   270→pub(crate) fn update_block_gas_counters(
   271→    accumulated_fee_statement: &FeeStatement,
   272→    accumulated_effective_gas: u64,
   273→    accumulated_approx_output_size: u64,
   274→    num_committed: usize,
   275→    is_parallel: bool,
   276→) {
   277→    let mode_str = if is_parallel {
   278→        Mode::PARALLEL
   279→    } else {
   280→        Mode::SEQUENTIAL
   281→    };
   282→

    25→/**
    26→================================ BlockSTMv2 Scheduler (SchedulerV2) ================================
    27→
    28→This module implements [SchedulerV2], the core component of the BlockSTMv2 execution engine.
    29→[SchedulerV2] orchestrates the parallel execution of transactions within a block, managing
    30→their lifecycle from initial scheduling through execution, potential aborts and re-executions,
    31→and eventual commit and post-commit processing.
    32→
    33→Key Responsibilities:
    34→---------------------
    35→1.  **Task Management**: [SchedulerV2] provides tasks to worker threads. These tasks can be
    36→    to execute a transaction, or to perform post-commit processing for a committed transaction.
    37→    It uses a [TaskKind] enum to represent these different types of tasks.
    38→
    39→2.  **Transaction Lifecycle Coordination**: It interacts closely with `ExecutionStatuses` (from
    40→    `scheduler_status.rs`) to track and update the state of each transaction (e.g.,
    41→    `PendingScheduling`, `Executing`, `Executed`, `Aborted`).
    42→
    43→3.  **Concurrency Control & Dependency Management**:
    44→    -   **Abort Handling**: It utilizes an [AbortManager] to handle invalidations. When a
    45→        transaction's execution output might affect other transactions that read its prior
    46→        state, those dependent transactions are aborted and rescheduled.
    47→    -   **Stall Propagation**: It manages [AbortedDependencies] to track which transactions
    48→        have been previously aborted due to changes in a dependency. This information is
    49→        used to implement a "stall" mechanism. If a transaction T_i is stalled (e.g.,
    50→        because a lower-indexed transaction T_j it depends on was aborted and T_j might
    51→        abort T_i again), T_i's re-execution might be deferred. Stalls propagate through
    52→        the dependency graph that the scheduler automatically builds and maintains.
    53→
    54→4.  **Commit Sequencing**: [SchedulerV2] ensures that transactions are committed in their
    55→    original sequence (by transaction index). It manages a `next_to_commit_idx` and uses
    56→    `CommitMarkerFlag`s to track the commit state of each transaction (NotCommitted,

    77→    to determine when all transactions in the block are fully processed and committed.

    84→    queue of transactions ready for execution. [SchedulerV2] interacts with it to pop
    85→    transactions for execution and to add transactions back (e.g., upon re-scheduling).

    89→    consumes the [AbortManager] to finalize these aborts and update dependencies.
    90→-   **Worker Threads**: Continuously request tasks from [SchedulerV2] via [SchedulerV2::next_task].

1.  **Task Management**: [SchedulerV2] provides tasks to worker threads. These tasks can be
    to execute a transaction, or to perform post-commit processing for a committed transaction.
    It uses a [TaskKind] enum to represent these different types of tasks.
2.  **Transaction Lifecycle Coordination**: It interacts closely with `ExecutionStatuses` (from
    `scheduler_status.rs`) to track and update the state of each transaction (e.g.,
    `PendingScheduling`, `Executing`, `Executed`, `Aborted`).
--
    transactions for execution and to add transactions back (e.g., upon re-scheduling).
-   **[AbortManager]**: Used by worker threads during `[SchedulerV2::finish_execution]`. When a worker
    completes a transaction, it uses the [AbortManager] to identify and initiate aborts for
    dependent transactions that read its (now potentially changed) output. [SchedulerV2]
    consumes the [AbortManager] to finalize these aborts and update dependencies.
-   **Worker Threads**: Continuously request tasks from [SchedulerV2] via [SchedulerV2::next_task].
    They execute these tasks and report results (e.g., via [SchedulerV2::finish_execution],
    [SchedulerV2::end_commit]).

/// Represents the different kinds of tasks that a worker thread can receive from [SchedulerV2].
///
/// This enum defines the instructions passed from [SchedulerV2::next_task] to an executor
/// (worker thread) to direct its activity.
#[derive(PartialEq, Debug)]
pub(crate) enum TaskKind {
    /// Instructs the worker to execute a specific `(TxnIndex, Incarnation)` of a transaction.
    /// The incarnation number starts at 0 for the first execution attempt and increments
    /// with each subsequent re-execution (after an abort).
    Execute(TxnIndex, Incarnation),
    /// Instructs the worker to perform post-commit processing for a given `TxnIndex`.
    /// This task is dispatched after a transaction has been successfully committed and its
    /// sequential client-side commit hook has been performed. The post-commit processing
    /// itself is assumed to be parallelizable and typically involves finalization or cleanup steps.
    PostCommitProcessing(TxnIndex),
    /// Signals that no specific task (like `Execute` or `PostCommitProcessing`) is immediately
    /// available from the scheduler. The worker should typically call [SchedulerV2::next_task]
    /// again soon, possibly after a brief pause or yielding, to check for new work.
    NextTask,
    /// Signals that all transactions have been processed and committed, and the scheduler
    /// has no more work. The worker thread receiving this task can terminate.
    Done,
--
    ///
    /// This method performs two main actions:
    /// 1. Updates the `committed_marker` for `txn_idx` from `CommitStarted` to `Committed`.
    ///    Panics if the previous marker was not `CommitStarted`.
    /// 2. Pushes `txn_idx` to the `post_commit_processing_queue`, making it available for
    ///    a `PostCommitProcessing` task to be dispatched by [SchedulerV2::next_task].
    ///    Panics if the queue push fails (e.g., if the queue is full, which shouldn't happen
    ///    given it's bounded by `num_txns`).
    ///
    /// It is crucial that `txn_idx` was previously obtained from a successful call to
    /// [SchedulerV2::start_commit], and that the `queueing_commits_lock` was held
--
    /// Fetches the next task for a worker thread.
    ///
    /// This is the primary method workers call to get work from the scheduler.
    /// The scheduler prioritizes tasks as follows:
    /// 1.  **`Done`**: If [SchedulerV2::is_done] is true, it returns `TaskKind::Done`.
    /// 2.  **`PostCommitProcessing`**: Attempts to pop a `txn_idx` from the
    ///     `post_commit_processing_queue`. If successful, returns
    ///     `TaskKind::PostCommitProcessing(txn_idx)`. If this was the last transaction
    ///     (`num_txns - 1`), it also sets `is_done` to true.
    /// 3.  **`Done` (if halted)**: If the `post_commit_processing_queue` is empty and
    ///     [SchedulerV2::is_halted] is true, returns `TaskKind::Done`.
    /// 4.  **`Execute`**: Attempts to pop a `txn_idx` from the main `execution_queue` via
    ///     `[ExecutionQueueManager::pop_next]` (accessed through `txn_statuses`). If successful,
    ///     it then calls [SchedulerV2::start_executing] to mark the transaction as `Executing`
    ///     and get its current incarnation. If [SchedulerV2::start_executing] returns
    ///     `Some(incarnation)`, it returns `TaskKind::Execute(txn_idx, incarnation)`.
    /// 5.  **`NextTask`**: If none of the above yield a task (e.g., queues are empty, no work
    ///     to start), it returns `TaskKind::NextTask`, indicating the worker should try again.
    ///
    /// Returns `Err(PanicError)` if an invariant is violated (e.g., commit queue closed).
    ///
    /// TODO: take worker ID, dedicate some workers to scan high priority tasks (can use armed lock).
    /// We can also have different versions (e.g. for testing) of next_task.

现在我找到了问题的根源！当前使用的是**BlockSTMv2**（`blockstm_v2: true`），它使用`SchedulerV2`，而`SchedulerV2`**没有独立的validation任务**。

**问题分析：**

1. **传统BlockSTM**: 有`ValidationTask`，每次execution后会有对应的validation
2. **BlockSTMv2**: 没有`ValidationTask`，只在以下两个地方调用validation：
   - `post_process_txn_output`: 最终validation（每个transaction一次）
   - `try_commit`: commit时的validation（每个transaction一次）

所以validation_calls只有100次（等于交易数量），而不是139次（所有incarnation数量）。

   336→            let from_raw = transaction_data.from_address.replace("account_", "");
   337→            let to_raw = transaction_data.to_address.replace("account_", "");
   338→            let value_raw = transaction_data.amount.to_string();
   339→            
   340→            // 规范化地址
   341→            let from_norm = from_raw.trim().to_lowercase();
   342→            let to_norm = to_raw.trim().to_lowercase();
   343→            
   344→            // 获取account_id
   345→            let from_account_id = account_id_map.get(&from_norm).copied().unwrap_or(0);
   346→            let to_account_id = account_id_map.get(&to_norm).copied().unwrap_or(0);
   347→            
   348→            // FungibleStore键ID（假设与account_id相同）
   349→            let key_from_id = from_account_id;
   350→            let key_to_id = to_account_id;
   351→            
   352→            // 计算行哈希
   353→            let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
   354→            hasher.update(format!("{}|{}|{}", from_raw, to_raw, value_raw));
   355→            let row_hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
   356→            
   357→            writeln!(mapping_file, 
   358→                "{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}",
   359→                format!("block_{:03}", self.current_block_id), // block_id
   360→                dataset, // dataset
   361→                csv_path, // source_csv
   362→                transaction_data.transaction_index + 1, // row_number (1开始)
   363→                idx + 1, // tx_index (1开始)
   364→                from_raw, // from_raw
   365→                to_raw, // to_raw
   366→                value_raw, // value_raw
   367→                from_norm, // from_norm
   368→                to_norm, // to_norm
   369→                from_account_id, // from_account_id
   370→                to_account_id, // to_account_id
   371→                key_from_id, // key_from_id
   372→                key_to_id, // key_to_id
   373→                "true", // included
   374→                "", // skip_reason
   375→                row_hash // row_hash
   376→                // 删除的冗余字段（可从日志文件计算）：
   377→                // - task_kind: 统计TaskPickedV2事件
   378→                // - first_execution: incarnation == 1
   379→                // - execution_time_us: ExecutionFinish.timestamp - ExecutionStart.timestamp
   380→                // - reexecution_count: max(incarnation) - 1
   381→                // - stall_count: 统计StallAdd事件数量
   382→                // - waterline_at_exec: 查找执行时最近的WaterlineAdvance事件
   383→                // - abort_count: 统计AbortInitiated事件数量
   384→            )?;
   385→        }
   386→        
   387→        println!("Generated row_tx_mapping.csv with {} entries at {}", csv_data.len(), mapping_path);
   388→        
   389→        // Generate additional files in the block directory
   390→        self.generate_code_map(&block_dir)?;
   391→        self.generate_meta_json(&block_dir, csv_path, csv_data.len())?;
   392→        
   393→        Ok(())
   394→    }

   396→    /// Update row_tx_mapping.csv with real execution statistics (DEPRECATED - 统计字段现已精简)
   397→    pub fn update_row_tx_mapping_with_stats(&self, _csv_path: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
   398→        // 此方法已废弃：统计字段已从CSV中移除，现在通过日志文件计算

   404→        // - abort_count: 统计每个transaction_id的AbortInitiated事件数量

   443→    /// Generate meta.json with run parameters and environment info
   444→    fn generate_meta_json(
   445→        &self,
   446→        block_dir: &str,
   447→        csv_path: &str,
   448→        tx_count: usize,
   449→    ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
   450→        use std::fs::File;
   451→        use std::io::Write;
   452→        use serde_json::json;
   453→
   454→        let meta_path = format!("{}/meta.json", block_dir);
   455→        let mut meta_file = File::create(&meta_path)?;
   456→
   457→        let dataset = if csv_path.contains("ETH") {
   458→            "ETH"
   459→        } else if csv_path.contains("USDT") {
   460→            "USDT"
   461→        } else {
   462→            "UNKNOWN"
   463→        };
   464→
   465→        let git_commit = std::env::var("GIT_COMMIT")
   466→            .or_else(|_| {
   467→                std::process::Command::new("git")
   468→                    .args(&["rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"])
   469→                    .output()
   470→                    .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
   471→                    .map_err(|_| std::env::VarError::NotPresent)
   472→            })
   473→            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
   474→
   475→        let build_profile = if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
   476→            "debug"
   477→        } else {
   478→            "release"
   479→        };
   480→
   481→        // Get actual Rust version
   482→        let rust_version = std::env::var("RUSTC_VERSION")
   483→            .or_else(|_| {
   484→                std::process::Command::new("rustc")
   485→                    .args(&["--version"])
   486→                    .output()
   487→                    .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
   488→                    .map_err(|_| std::env::VarError::NotPresent)
   489→            })
   490→            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
   491→
   492→        let meta = json!({
   493→            "block_id": format!("block_{:03}", self.current_block_id),
   494→            "dataset": dataset,
   495→            "source_csv": csv_path,
   496→            "tx_count": tx_count,
   497→            "concurrency_level": self.concurrency_level, // 使用实际传入的并发级别
   498→            "sample_period_ms": std::env::var("SAMPLE_PERIOD_MS")
   499→                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "50".to_string())
   500→                .parse::<u32>()
   501→                .unwrap_or(50),
   502→            "read_sample_rate": std::env::var("READ_SAMPLE_RATE")
   503→                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0.01".to_string())
   504→                .parse::<f64>()
   505→                .unwrap_or(0.01),
   506→            "git_commit": git_commit,
   507→            "build_profile": build_profile,
   508→            "log_output_dir": self.log_output_dir.as_ref().unwrap_or(&"./logs".to_string()),
   509→            "timestamp": SystemTime::now()
   510→                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
   511→                .unwrap_or_default()
   512→                .as_secs(),
   513→            "address_mapping_summary": {
   514→                "unique_accounts": tx_count * 2, // 估计值，每个交易有from和to
   515→                "fungible_store_keys": tx_count * 2,
   516→                "normalization_applied": true
   517→            },
   518→            "environment": {
   519→                "rust_version": rust_version,
   520→                "aptos_core_version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
   521→                "host_os": std::env::consts::OS,
   522→                "host_arch": std::env::consts::ARCH,
   523→                "cpu_count": num_cpus::get()
   524→            }
   525→        });
   526→
   527→        writeln!(meta_file, "{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&meta)?)?;
   528→        println!("Generated meta.json at {}", meta_path);
   529→        Ok(())
   530→    }

   532→    // 新增：处理交易映射
   533→    pub fn process_transaction_mapping(&self, transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction]) {
   534→        if !self.log_enabled || self.csv_data.is_none() {
   535→            return;
   536→        }
   537→        
   538→        if let Some(ref csv_data) = self.csv_data {
   539→            for (block_stm_index, csv_record) in csv_data.iter().enumerate() {
   540→                if block_stm_index < transactions.len() {
   541→                     // 记录交易映射关系
   542→                     if let Some(logger) = aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   543→                         logger.log_performance_metric(
   544→                             "transaction_mapping",
   545→                             block_stm_index as f64,
   546→                             Some(block_stm_index as u32),
   547→                             std::collections::HashMap::from([
   548→                                 ("csv_index".to_string(), csv_record.transaction_index.to_string()),
   549→                                 ("block_id".to_string(), self.current_block_id.to_string()),
   550→                                 ("mapping_type".to_string(), "CSV_to_BlockSTM".to_string()),
   551→                                 ("transaction_hash".to_string(), csv_record.transaction_hash.clone()),
   552→                                 ("block_stm_index".to_string(), block_stm_index.to_string()),
   553→                             ])
   554→                         );
   555→                     }
   556→                 }
   557→            }
   558→        }
   559→    }

   561→    // 新增：从CSV文件读取交易数据
   562→    pub fn load_transactions_from_csv(
   563→        &mut self,
   564→        csv_file_path: &str,
   565→        max_transactions: Option<usize>,
   566→    ) -> Result<(Vec<SignatureVerifiedTransaction>, Vec<CsvTransactionRecord>), String> {
   567→        let file = File::open(csv_file_path)
   568→            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to open CSV file: {}", e))?;
   569→        let reader = BufReader::new(file);
   570→        
   571→        let mut csv_records = Vec::new();
   572→        let mut transaction_graph = Vec::new();
   573→        let _address_to_account_idx: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
   574→        let _next_account_idx = 0;
   575→        
   576→        for (line_idx, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
   577→            if line_idx == 0 { continue; } // 跳过标题行
   578→            
   579→            if let Some(max) = max_transactions {
   580→                if line_idx > max {
   581→                    break;
   582→                }
   583→            }
   584→            
   585→            let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("Failed to read line {}: {}", line_idx, e))?;
   586→            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split(',').collect();
   587→            
   588→            if parts.len() < 3 {
   589→                continue; // 跳过格式不正确的行
   590→            }
   591→            
   592→            // 解析发送方和接收方账户索引
   593→            let sender_idx = parts[0].trim().parse::<usize>()
   594→                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid sender index at line {}: {}", line_idx, e))?;
   595→            let receiver_idx = parts[1].trim().parse::<usize>()
   596→                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid receiver index at line {}: {}", line_idx, e))?;
   597→            
   598→            // 确保有足够的账户
   599→            if sender_idx >= self.account_universe.num_accounts() || 
   600→               receiver_idx >= self.account_universe.num_accounts() {
   601→                return Err(format!("Account index out of range at line {}. Sender: {}, Receiver: {}, Available accounts: {}", 
   602→                                 line_idx, sender_idx, receiver_idx, self.account_universe.num_accounts()));
   603→            }
   604→            
   605→            transaction_graph.push((sender_idx, receiver_idx));
   606→            
   607→            // 创建CSV记录
   608→            let sender_addr = format!("account_{}", sender_idx);
   609→            let receiver_addr = format!("account_{}", receiver_idx);
   610→            let amount = parts.get(2).unwrap_or(&"1000000").trim().parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(1000000);
   611→            let timestamp = parts.get(3).unwrap_or(&"0").trim().parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0);
   612→            
   613→            csv_records.push(CsvTransactionRecord {
   614→                csv_index: line_idx - 1, // 减1因为跳过了标题行
   615→                sender_address: sender_addr,
   616→                receiver_address: receiver_addr,
   617→                amount,
   618→                timestamp,
   619→                transaction_hash: format!("csv_txn_{}", line_idx - 1),
   620→            });
   621→        }
   622→        
   623→        println!("Loaded {} transaction records from CSV", csv_records.len());
   624→        
   625→        // 生成交易
   626→        let transactions = self.gen_transaction_for_erc20(transaction_graph);
   627→        
   628→        Ok((transactions, csv_records))
   629→    }

   662→
   663→    pub fn gen_transaction_for_erc20(&mut self,transaction_graph:Vec<(usize,usize)>) -> Vec<SignatureVerifiedTransaction> {
   664→        let mut account_num_max = 0;
   665→        let mut seq_map: HashMap<usize, usize> = HashMap::new();
   666→        let mut signed_transactions = Vec::new();
   667→        for tuple in &transaction_graph{
   668→            account_num_max = account_num_max.max(tuple.0).max(tuple.1);
   669→            let sender = self.account_universe.account(tuple.0);
   670→            let receiver = self.account_universe.account(tuple.1);
   671→            let entry = seq_map.entry(tuple.0);
   672→            match entry {
   673→                std::collections::hash_map::Entry::Occupied(mut occupied)=>{
   674→                    *occupied.get_mut()+=1;
   675→                }
   676→                std::collections::hash_map::Entry::Vacant(vacant) => {
   677→                    vacant.insert(sender.sequence_number() as usize);
   678→                }
   679→            };
   680→            let txn = peer_to_peer_txn(
   681→                sender.account(), 
   682→                receiver.account(), 
   683→                seq_map[&tuple.0] as u64, 
   684→                1,
   685→                100
   686→            );
   687→            // println!("gen txn: {:?} to {:?} :{}",sender.account().address(),receiver.account().address(),1);
   688→            signed_transactions.push(txn);   
   689→        }
   690→        let transactions: Vec<Transaction> = signed_transactions
   691→            .into_iter()
   692→            .map(|txn| {
   693→                Transaction::UserTransaction(txn)
   694→            })
   695→            .collect();
   696→        into_signature_verified_block(transactions)       
   697→    }
   698→
   699→    fn execute_and_apply_transactions(
   700→        &mut self,
   701→        signed_transactions:Vec<SignedTransaction>,
   702→    ){
   703→        let signature_verified_transactions = into_signature_verified_block(
   704→            signed_transactions
   705→            .into_iter()
   706→            .map(|txn| {
   707→                Transaction::UserTransaction(txn)
   708→            })
   709→            .collect()
   710→        );
   711→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(signature_verified_transactions);
   712→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   713→        let output = block_executor.execute_block(
   714→            &txn_provider,
   715→            self.executor.state_store(),
   716→            aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_no_block_limit(),
   717→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   718→        )
   719→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   720→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   721→        output.iter().for_each(|txn_output| {
   722→            assert_eq!(
   723→                txn_output.status(),
   724→                &TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success)
   725→            );
   726→            self.executor.state_store().apply_write_set(txn_output.write_set()).unwrap();
   727→        });
   728→    }
   729→
   730→    fn execute_benchmark_sequential(
   731→        &self,
   732→        transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction],
   733→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
   734→    ) -> (Vec<TransactionOutput>, usize) {
   735→        use aptos_block_executor::counters;
   736→        use aptos_types::block_executor::config::{BlockExecutorConfig, BlockExecutorLocalConfig, BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig};
   737→        
   738→        let block_size = transactions.len();
   739→        
   740→        // Reset counters before execution
   741→        let execution_before = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   742→        let validation_before = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   743→        let abort_before = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get();
   744→        
   745→        let timer = Instant::now();
   746→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(transactions.to_vec());
   747→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   748→        
   749→        let config = BlockExecutorConfig {
   750→            local: BlockExecutorLocalConfig {
   751→                blockstm_v2: true,
   752→                concurrency_level: 1,
   753→                allow_fallback: true,
   754→                discard_failed_blocks: false,
   755→                module_cache_config: BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig::default(),
   756→            },
   757→            onchain: aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_maybe_block_limit(maybe_block_gas_limit),
   758→        };
   759→        
   760→        let output = block_executor.execute_block_with_config(
   761→            &txn_provider,
   762→            self.executor.state_store(),
   763→            config,
   764→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   765→        )
   766→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   767→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   768→        let exec_time = timer.elapsed().as_millis();
   769→        
   770→        // Calculate deltas for this execution
   771→        let execution_total = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - execution_before;
   772→        let validation_total = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - validation_before;
   773→        let abort = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get() - abort_before;
   774→        
   775→        // Note: Sequential execution, no stall mechanism
   776→        println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{}", 
   777→            execution_total, validation_total, abort);
   778→        (output, block_size * 1000 / exec_time as usize)
   779→    }
   780→
   781→    fn execute_benchmark_parallel(
   782→        &self,
   783→        transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction],
   784→        concurrency_level_per_shard: usize,
   785→        maybe_block_gas_limit: Option<u64>,
   786→    ) -> (Vec<TransactionOutput>, usize) {
   787→        use aptos_block_executor::counters;
   788→        use aptos_types::block_executor::config::{BlockExecutorConfig, BlockExecutorLocalConfig, BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig};
   789→        
   790→        let block_size = transactions.len();
   791→        
   792→        
   793→        // 记录区块执行开始
   794→        if self.log_enabled {
   795→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution start: block {}, {} transactions, concurrency {}", 
   796→                    self.current_block_id, block_size, concurrency_level_per_shard);
   797→        }
   798→        
   799→        // Reset counters before execution
   800→        let execution_before = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   801→        let validation_before = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   802→        let abort_before = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get();
   803→        
   804→        // Reset BlockSTM logger stall statistics
   805→        if let Some(logger) = aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   806→            logger.reset_stall_statistics();
   807→        }
   808→        
   809→        let timer = Instant::now();
   810→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(transactions.to_vec());
   811→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   812→        
   813→        let config = BlockExecutorConfig {
   814→            local: BlockExecutorLocalConfig {
   815→                blockstm_v2: true,
   816→                concurrency_level: concurrency_level_per_shard,
   817→                allow_fallback: true,
   818→                discard_failed_blocks: false,
   819→                module_cache_config: BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig::default(),
   820→            },
   821→            onchain: aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_maybe_block_limit(maybe_block_gas_limit),
   822→        };
   823→        
   824→        let output = block_executor.execute_block_with_config(
   825→            &txn_provider,
   826→            self.executor.state_store(),
   827→            config,
   828→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   829→        )
   830→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   831→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   832→        let exec_time = timer.elapsed().as_millis();
   833→        
   834→        // Calculate deltas for this execution
   835→        let execution_total = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - execution_before;
   836→        let validation_total = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - validation_before;
   837→        let abort = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get() - abort_before;
   838→        
   839→        // Get real stall statistics from BlockSTMLogger
   840→        let (stall, stall_time_total, avg_stall_time) = if let Some(logger) = 
   841→            aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   842→            let stall_count = logger.get_stall_events_count() as u64;
   843→            // Get real total stall time in microseconds and convert to seconds
   844→            let total_time_us = logger.get_total_stall_time_us() as f64;
   845→            let total_time = total_time_us / 1_000_000.0; // Convert microseconds to seconds
   846→            let avg_time = if stall_count > 0 { total_time / stall_count as f64 } else { 0.0 };
   847→            (stall_count, total_time, avg_time)
   848→        } else {
   849→            // If logger not available, report zero stall statistics
   850→            (0u64, 0.0f64, 0.0f64)
   851→        };
   852→        
   853→        let tps = block_size * 1000 / exec_time as usize;
   854→        
   855→        // 记录区块执行结束
   856→        if self.log_enabled {
   857→            let successful_txns = output.iter().filter(|o| matches!(o.status(), TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success))).count();
   858→            let aborted_txns = output.len() - successful_txns;
   859→            
   860→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution end: block {}, {} transactions, successful: {}, failed: {}", 
   861→                    self.current_block_id, block_size, successful_txns, aborted_txns);
   862→        }
   863→        
   864→        // Print execution statistics 
   865→        println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{}, stall_count:{}, avg_stall_time:{:.2} us, stall_time_total:{:.2} us", 
   866→            execution_total,
   867→            validation_total,
   868→            abort,
   869→            stall,  // This is scheduler-level stall count (add_stall/remove_stall operations)
   870→            avg_stall_time * 1000000.0,
   871→            stall_time_total * 1000000.0
   872→        );
   873→        (output, tps)
   874→    }

   876→    // 新增：增强的并行执行方法，返回详细指标
   877→    fn execute_benchmark_parallel_with_metrics(
   878→        &self,
   879→        transactions: &[SignatureVerifiedTransaction],
   880→        concurrency_level_per_shard: usize,

   883→        use aptos_block_executor::counters;

   885→

   889→        if self.log_enabled {

   891→                    self.current_block_id, block_size, concurrency_level_per_shard);
   892→        }
   893→        
   894→        // Reset counters before execution
   895→        let execution_before = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   896→        let validation_before = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   897→        let abort_before = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get();
   898→        let suspend_before = counters::DEPENDENCY_WAIT_SECONDS.get_sample_count();
   899→        let suspend_time_before = counters::DEPENDENCY_WAIT_SECONDS.get_sample_sum();
   900→        
   901→        let timer = Instant::now();
   902→        let txn_provider = DefaultTxnProvider::new_without_info(transactions.to_vec());
   903→        let block_executor = AptosVMBlockExecutor::new();
   904→        
   905→        let config = BlockExecutorConfig {
   906→            local: BlockExecutorLocalConfig {
   907→                blockstm_v2: true,
   908→                concurrency_level: concurrency_level_per_shard,
   909→                allow_fallback: true,
   910→                discard_failed_blocks: false,
   911→                module_cache_config: BlockExecutorModuleCacheLocalConfig::default(),
   912→            },
   913→            onchain: aptos_types::block_executor::config::BlockExecutorConfigFromOnchain::new_maybe_block_limit(maybe_block_gas_limit),
   914→        };
   915→        
   916→        let output = block_executor.execute_block_with_config(
   917→            &txn_provider,
   918→            self.executor.state_store(),
   919→            config,
   920→            aptos_types::block_executor::transaction_slice_metadata::TransactionSliceMetadata::unknown(),
   921→        )
   922→        .expect("VM should not fail to start")
   923→        .into_transaction_outputs_forced();
   924→        let exec_time = timer.elapsed().as_millis();
   925→        
   926→        // Calculate deltas for this execution
   927→        let execution_total = counters::TASK_EXECUTE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - execution_before;
   928→        let validation_total = counters::TASK_VALIDATE_SECONDS.get_sample_count() - validation_before;
   929→        let abort = counters::SPECULATIVE_ABORT_COUNT.get() - abort_before;
   930→        
   931→        // Get real stall statistics from BlockSTMLogger
   932→        let (stall, stall_time_total, avg_stall_time) = if let Some(logger) = 
   933→            aptos_block_executor::block_stm_logger::get_global_logger() {
   934→            let stall_count = logger.get_stall_events_count() as u64;
   935→            // Get real total stall time in microseconds and convert to seconds
   936→            let total_time_us = logger.get_total_stall_time_us() as f64;
   937→            let total_time = total_time_us / 1_000_000.0; // Convert microseconds to seconds
   938→            let avg_time = if stall_count > 0 { total_time / stall_count as f64 } else { 0.0 };
   939→            (stall_count, total_time, avg_time)
   940→        } else {
   941→            // If logger not available, report zero stall statistics
   942→            (0u64, 0.0f64, 0.0f64)
   943→        };
   944→        
   945→        let tps = block_size * 1000 / exec_time as usize;
   946→        
   947→        // 记录区块执行结束
   948→        if self.log_enabled {
   949→            let successful_txns = output.iter().filter(|o| matches!(o.status(), TransactionStatus::Keep(ExecutionStatus::Success))).count();
   950→            let aborted_txns = output.len() - successful_txns;
   951→            
   952→            println!("Block-STM parallel execution with metrics end: block {}, TPS: {}, successful: {}, aborted: {}", 
   953→                    self.current_block_id, tps, successful_txns, aborted_txns);
   954→        }
   955→        
   956→        let metrics = DetailedExecutionMetrics {
   957→            execution_count: execution_total,
   958→            validation_count: validation_total,
   959→            abort_count: abort,
   960→            stall_count: stall,
   961→            avg_stall_time_us: avg_stall_time * 1000000.0,
   962→            total_stall_time_us: stall_time_total * 1000000.0,
   963→            execution_time_ms: exec_time,
   964→            tps,
   965→        };
   966→        
   967→        // Note: Detailed stall analysis available in generated log files
   968→        if self.log_enabled {
   969→            println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{} (detailed metrics in logs and return value)", 
   970→                execution_total, validation_total, abort);
   971→        } else {
   972→            println!("execution_calls:{}, validation_calls:{}, abort_count:{}, stall_count:{}, avg_stall_time:{:.2} us, stall_time_total:{:.2} us", 
   973→                execution_total,
   974→                validation_total,
   975→                abort,
   976→                stall,
   977→                avg_stall_time * 1000000.0,
   978→                stall_time_total * 1000000.0
   979→            );
   980→        }
   981→        
   982→        (output, metrics)
   983→    }
